## [1.5.0-dev.1](https://github.com/Hiosdra/morphe-patches/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0-dev.1) (2026-09-27)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* add VesselFinder advertisement suppression patch ([0c67061](https://github.com/Hiosdra/morphe-patches/commit/0c67061081f5c18bd5ff69d407f5e5885c0bff4e))
* **f1:** preserve playback position when entering pip ([7a56aad](https://github.com/Hiosdra/morphe-patches/commit/7a56aadc786c2432fa4b09de3536617872d5e6f6))
* **f1:** target version 3.0.49.4 on dev ([88f3129](https://github.com/Hiosdra/morphe-patches/commit/88f3129f1e9d9a310ca6699ab8aa69281c86c44d))

### ✨ New Features

* add Movie Paradise GmsCore (microG) support for Google login ([7bf44b4](https://github.com/Hiosdra/morphe-patches/commit/7bf44b4dea6361e20eca6a00ac826acb95cfc0d9))
* add Movie Paradise patches (PairIP bypass + experimental RevenueCat premium) ([d08a74c](https://github.com/Hiosdra/morphe-patches/commit/d08a74c8371b707b4b8b9c8374da74d0e2a9fb38))
* **f1:** add standalone package and update patches ([8341c21](https://github.com/Hiosdra/morphe-patches/commit/8341c21ff66abd1e6cff12a3715b61c12d89426d))
* **release:** advance dev prerelease for Morphe discovery ([b58a370](https://github.com/Hiosdra/morphe-patches/commit/b58a37016a80345b884b54eac3cb62e33e91d77b))

patches.name: VesselFinder - Disable advertisements
patches.description: Prevents the VesselFinder advertisement plugin from creating or showing banner ads.

patches.name: F1 TV - Background playback
patches.description: Keeps the F1 TV player alive when the activity goes to the background or the screen turns off.

patches.name: F1 TV - Change package name
patches.description: Changes the F1 TV package name to allow installing a separate patched instance. By default ".morphe" is appended to the package name.

options.description: Package name to use for the cloned F1 TV app.
Update custom permissions declared by F1 TV. This can fix installation conflicts, but may break app features.
Update provider names declared by F1 TV. This can fix installation conflicts, but may break app features.

patches.name: F1 TV - Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Disables Play Store updates for the F1 TV package by setting its version code to the maximum allowed.

patches.name: F1 TV - Foreground playback service
patches.description: Keeps background F1 TV playback alive with an Android media playback notification and playback/PiP controls.

patches.name: F1 TV - Picture-in-Picture
patches.description: Keeps F1 TV playback alive while entering Android Picture-in-Picture mode.

patches.name: Movie Paradise - Force RevenueCat entitlement (experimental)
patches.description: Forces RevenueCat entitlements active. Experimental: premium is server-authoritative, so this likely unlocks nothing.

patches.name: Movie Paradise - GmsCore support (microG login)
patches.description: Routes Google Play Services through microG (MicroG-RE) so Google sign-in works without stock Play Services.

patches.name: Movie Paradise - PairIP license bypass
patches.description: Neutralises Google Play integrity/license checks (PairIP) so a repackaged build launches.
